segment: A0-DEF-2 is repaired in the product and published on the serving composition; the recorded stop route now imports the same plugins as the live module, and the receiver serves both user areas again

defect.exact_mechanism: the recorded stop route is a byte copy of the pinned native runtime that lives in a job directory. It was executed with its own __import__, so it did not inherit the scoped import replacement that the live module receives: 'plugins.friday_rework.supervision' resolves to the hermes-agent plugins package, which has no friday_rework part, so the import failed and the exact-owner cleanup stayed unconfirmed (StopUnconfirmed).
defect.why_the_bundles_work: the live module executes with the replacement, where 'from . import supervision' resolves inside the product's own plugin package; the recorded copy had no such replacement.
defect.repair: both execution points of the recorded route (host_runtime._route_module and a0_bootstrap's stop path) now give the recorded code the SAME scoped import replacement as the live module, and the composition's plugins directory is placed on sys.path so that the product's own plugin package resolves. The replacement uses the absolute package name, because the recorded route runs outside the package.
defect.verified: the recorded route of a real prior attempt was executed with the repaired replacement in the product's own environment: native_supervisor is built (NativeSupervisor) and the module exposes its 55 callables; before the repair the same execution failed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'plugins.friday_rework'.
